## Description
Using gitea 1.13.2 and postgres 13.0 I still have the following reoccuring postgres errors:

2021-02-16 21:31:14.345 UTC [20446] ERROR:  duplicate key value violates unique constraint "email_hash_pkey"
2021-02-16 21:31:14.345 UTC [20446] DETAIL:  Key (hash)=(xxxxxxxxxx) already exists.
2021-02-16 21:31:14.345 UTC [20446] STATEMENT:  INSERT INTO "email_hash" ("hash","email") VALUES ($1,$2)

I understand that this should be fixed in 1.13.0 via https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/12577 
...
